Conclusion
Religion continues to shape foodways around the globe, not only in traditional forms of fasting and celebrations or food taboos,
but in particular in the ethical attitude toward our fellow creatures as well as our responsibility for stewardship of the environment,
and most importantly for the responsibility we owe to perform works of charity to help sustain our fellow humans.
